post_ship_review.scope: full-collection re-sweep audit (Codex GPT-5.6-sol candidate-error sweep + independent Claude adversarial verification)
post_ship_review.fix: 18 candidate findings adversarially verified -> 14 CONFIRMED + 4 NEEDS_NUANCE, all applied. Highlights: Generalized-JSD beta=0/1 endpoints are literal 0 (must use one-sided limits, direction opposite of naive intuition); MiniLLM's actual policy gradient uses a return-to-go single-step decomposition (not plain B1 semi-gradient); OPD+GRPO's r_kl_dense is a trajectory-level scalar broadcast to all tokens, not real per-token dense reward; Route B needs a logprob-only (gray-box) teacher, not a true sample-only black-box API; sampled-token gather saves storage/transfer not compute; teacher-probability-near-zero case makes the reverse-KL term explode to +inf, not vanish to 0; OPD value-function baseline is a single-step conditional expectation, not the true trajectory V(s); bit-rate arithmetic N*17/10 corrected to 1.7N (3400-13600x, not 200-1000x); naive Route-A code's five [B,L,V] tensors (~33-50GB) reconciled against the Sec 8.2 memory table; teacher forward is one call over the full sequence, not one per prefix; Sec 8.3 relabeled Sample Efficiency -> Compute Efficiency throughout; RLHF is NOT a beta->0 special case; Kim&Rush/DistilBERT/R1-Distill years and DistilBERT stats corrected; Gemma 2/3 reclassified from OPD to off-policy soft-target KD (Qwen3/R1-Distill timeline/pipeline entries also disentangled); added needs-verify tags for Qwen3 pass@64 specifics, Thinking Machines FLOPs multiplier, and DeepSeek-V4 details.

NEEDS_NUANCE items were softened/qualified rather than reversed. Applied to both ZH and EN editions; EN is a faithful translation of the same substantive fixes.
